meta.name: Quieta
meta.author: Sunnyside
meta.essence: Quiet residences · Detail image beside content
meta.promise: Warm stone homes, sculptural interiors and soft garden light — a property brand for houses that are sold and let by being looked at closely.
meta.family: One house in elevation: a floating roof slab, a wall mass, a threshold cut.
meta.oneSentence: Quieta is a property identity built from lime-plastered walls, honed travertine, terracotta and olive shade, with an arched-threshold Kuwayama mark and a 6-mark architectural cast.

theme.family: constructed — Kuwayama parametric vector discipline, warm-stone material bias
theme.material: lime-plastered garden walls, honed travertine, oiled oak, terracotta urns, olive canopy and low garden light
theme.edge: precision organic — 10px inner / 18px outer concentric radii, 1px stone hairlines
theme.stroke: zero line icons; filled geometric vectors only, one 2-unit reveal seam as the single detail cut
theme.tile: gallery-airy asymmetric rhythm, 66ch reading measure, detail image always paired beside content
theme.density: gallery airy (104px section padding, 28px cell padding, wide leading)
theme.fieldRecipe: soft garden light raking across a plastered stone wall with dappled olive shadow
theme.markForm: a 54x8u cantilevered roof slab floating 5u above a 44x35u wall mass, with a 12x25u threshold notch cut through the wall to the ground line
